name: District of Columbia
agency: Metropolitan Police Department, Harbor Patrol Unit

rule.textEn: Anyone operating a vessel on District of Columbia waterways must hold a Boating Safety Certificate.
rule.textEs: Toda persona que maneje una embarcación en las aguas del Distrito de Columbia debe tener un Boating Safety Certificate.

card.feeNote: MPD Harbor Patrol runs a free one-day, 8-hour course (pre-registration by phone).

sources.quote: Anyone operating a vessel on District of Columbia waterways is required to have a Boating Safety Certificate.
The training is free; photo ID is required.
